_comment: Task 38 lane D — normalized native decision oracle. This is the 'executable native fixture' the parity suite runs against: it encodes the NATIVE-side decision tables transcribed verbatim from the C++ source (line provenance below), NOT the TypeScript constants. The parity tests assert the TS runtime output equals these native values, so a one-sided drift (TS changed, native not) fails exact parity. This is normalized SEMANTIC parity (decision outputs), never source-text equivalence. LIMITATION (production gap): the values are transcribed from source, not captured from a live native /mcp runtime; the integrator must wire a live native comparison to close the transcription gap.

fallback.tasksNote: Task 44 made tasks server-backed on BOTH transports (FMcpTaskSurface natively, BoundedTaskStore in TypeScript), so a Tasks-declaring client now resolves to the native tasks/list and only a Tasks-blind client falls back to the gateway execute operation.

unknownTool.messageFormat: Direct tool calls are removed. '{tool}' is not a known tool; call the 'unreal' gateway with operation 'search' to discover the right capability.

knownNoAction.messageFormat: Direct tool calls are removed. Call the 'unreal' gateway: describe '{tool}' to choose an action, then execute it.

knownWithAction.messageFormat: Direct tool calls are removed. Call the 'unreal' gateway with operation 'execute' to run '{tool}.{action}'.

directCallMigration.actionSelection: trimmed non-empty string action wins, else trimmed non-empty subAction, else no action
